notes: Slam probe for Black Hole: a game is started and public -1 (GTS80_SWSLAMTILT, read on RIOT U5 PA7 rather than through the matrix) is set to 1 for half a second, which PinMAME presents to the ROM as the normally closed slam contact opening. The manual (page 6, F) says a slam ends the game for all players and lights GAME OVER.
